name: nativehttp/client
description: Pure-PHP HTTP client with its own TLS 1.3 and HTTP/2 stack and a modern browser TLS fingerprint. No ext-curl, no external binaries, no dependencies.

suggest.ext-gmp: Fast RSA-PSS signature verification (bcmath is used when gmp is missing)
suggest.ext-bcmath: Fallback for RSA-PSS when gmp is not available

scripts.lint: find src examples tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P4 php -l
